shared_qualifications: Table 2 (PDF p.5) labels its solutions aerated, whereas the experimental method uses argon de-aeration and an argon-purged glove box (PDF pp.2-3); this source conflict is retained. It does not remove the independent alloy, electrolyte and pH identities.

Table 1 gives Cr19.2/Ni9.0 wt%, but C<0.05, N<0.002 and S<0.025 wt% (PDF p.3). CRA stores those limit numbers as exact cells and calculates a precise Fe value; neither the limits nor source Fe balance are asserted to be exact measured compositions here.

All source potentials are versus SCE. The anodic sweep is1 mV/s after cathodic polarization at-1.150 V(SCE) for15 min (PDF p.3). Source temperature is not independently established as a numerical25 C in these passages. The pH9 NaOH-adjusted NaCl condition is distinct from the Na2MoO4-added solution, whose table entry is transpassive rather than one of these Epit values.
